data.short_meaning: A female gazelle; (also) a poetess's name
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root خ-ن-س (kh-n-s); al-Khansāʾ was a famous pre-Islamic poetess. Its root is خ-ن-س (kh-n-s). Al-Khansāʾ, a celebrated 7th-century Arabic poetess. Khansa' is a Arabic name meaning “A female gazelle; (also) a poetess's name”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khansa' total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
